semantics_boundary: ESP32-S3 rows use FreeRTOS APIs/semantics; nRF54L15 rows use Zephyr APIs/semantics. Never transfer FreeRTOS Task/Queue/PM APIs or priority meanings to Zephyr.
status_semantics: HOST_COVERED means a manifest-backed behavioral host test and referenced mutation exist; it is coverage inventory, not a PASS or proof that this turn ran the test. HOST_PARTIAL records incomplete host evidence. TARGET/HIL rows stay BLOCKED_NO_BOARD until an activated fault and oracle are captured. Optional reports attach execution results only to a local run manifest.
